segments.title: 第183章 雨露均沾
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 183: Showering Favors Evenly

After their morning run, Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng had breakfast nearby. Then, Yan Zhusheng went back to her dorm to get her schoolbag and followed Li Luo to Bi Hai Lan Ting, apartment 1502.

It was only six-thirty in the morning.

The living room was quiet, without a single soul in sight.

Yan Zhusheng followed Li Luo into the apartment, changed into slippers in the entryway, and glanced curiously toward Xu Youyu's bedroom.

"Why is Senior Sister gone?" Yan Zhusheng asked, puzzled.

Because Xu Youyu had gone to Li Luo's bedroom last night, her own bedroom door was left open, so Yan Zhusheng could see the empty bed at a glance.

After asking this question, Yan Zhusheng took two more steps inside, only to find that Ying Chanxi's bedroom was also empty. Her face immediately grew even more suspicious.

"Ahem..." Li Luo coughed twice, a little embarrassed, and explained, "After the three of us came back last night, we watched a movie in my room. We got too tired, so they both just fell asleep in my room."

Hearing this answer, Yan Zhusheng's eyes widened slightly, then lit up. "I know this! You wrote about it in your book."

"Mo Qinghan and Shen Dongdong got tired from watching TV shows all night, so they fell asleep right on the male lead's bed."

"And then the three of them slept in the same bed. When the two female leads woke up in the middle of the night, they even secretly kissed the male lead, right?"

"..." The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched, but he still reminded her seriously, "That's what I wrote in my book, yes, but they didn't kiss me last night. Don't just substitute fiction for reality."

"But how would you know if Xixi and Senior Sister secretly kissed you while you were asleep?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and asked. "So theoretically, it's still possible that they kissed you, right?"

Li Luo: "...Where did you learn such twisted logic?"

"But Mo Qinghan is supposed to be me," Yan Zhusheng said. "Why did it become Senior Sister in reality?"

"First, this isn't reality. Second, you aren't Mo Qinghan. It's better if we clarify these two points first."

Li Luo pushed her down onto the sofa and sighed, "I knew I shouldn't have let you know about my writing. If you keep treating it as reality, I won't let you read my drafts anymore."

"Oh..." Hearing this, Yan Zhusheng instantly became much more behaved and said obediently, "Then I won't say it anymore."

"You can watch some TV." Li Luo handed her the living room remote, then stood up and said, "I'm going to get some more sleep."

After all, he had only slept for a little over three hours last night. When he first woke up in the morning, flanked by the fragrant and soft bodies of the girls, he had felt exceptionally alert.

But after his morning run and breakfast, he started to feel drowsy.

So, after some thought, Li Luo decided to go back to sleep to avoid being sluggish during the day.

When Yan Zhusheng heard he was going to sleep, she immediately asked curiously, "Are you going to sleep with Xixi and the others?"

"Of course not." Li Luo rolled his eyes and pointed to the small, empty bedroom opposite Xu Youyu's. "There's still a spare room in the apartment. I'll just make do in there for a while."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded and turned on the TV to watch.

But after Li Luo went into the guest room, and Yan Zhusheng had watched TV for a while, her head began to nod like she was pounding garlic, dropping down from time to time as her eyes grew hazy.

In truth, after watching the fireworks Li Luo and the others set off last night, she had savored the memory in bed for a long time before finally falling asleep.

She only woke up because she had set an alarm for five in the morning.

Her original plan was to send Li Luo a text. If he was still asleep and didn't reply, she would go back to sleep.

Unexpectedly, Li Luo was already awake and had even gone out for a morning run.

So, Yan Zhusheng got out of bed and ran out to join Li Luo, which was how she arrived at Bi Hai Lan Ting so early.

But now, she couldn't hold on any longer; she was extremely sleepy.

Without quite knowing what she was thinking, she casually turned off the TV, swayed to her feet, and walked into the guest room where Li Luo was.

Around seven in the morning.

In the master bedroom, Xu Youyu was woken by a biological urge and groggily opened her eyes.

But as her surroundings came into focus, she suddenly became wide awake.

She glanced around and realized she was sleeping on Li Luo's bed. She immediately clutched her head and tried to recall last night's events.

The original plan was to go back to her own room to sleep after the movie... Xu Youyu scratched her hair, feeling a little awkward.

She became even more embarrassed when she noticed that the quilt covering her was the one from her own bedroom.

She turned her head to look. Only Ying Chanxi was still in the bed; that guy Li Luo was nowhere to be seen.

After some thought, Xu Youyu looked down at her pajamas, which were perfectly smooth.

She rubbed her chest, wondering if her junior brother had done anything mischievous late last night.

With Xixi right beside them, he shouldn't have dared to try anything.

At this thought, Xu Youyu gingerly climbed out of bed.

She then picked up her quilt, tiptoed out of Li Luo's master bedroom, went to the bathroom, and returned to her own room.

Then she flopped onto her bed to catch some more sleep.

As for Li Luo, Xu Youyu guessed he had gone for his morning run. Without giving it much more thought, she fell asleep almost instantly.

The time was now a little past eight in the morning.

Ying Chanxi finally woke up from her deep sleep and stretched languidly in Li Luo's bed.

The next second, she sensed something was off about her surroundings. She looked around carefully, and her mind went blank for a moment.

This... this... this is Li Luo's bedroom?!

The moment she realized this, her little face flushed beet-red. She subconsciously looked beside her, but she didn't see anyone.

This made her sigh in relief, just a little.

If Li Luo had been lying next to her right then, Ying Chanxi wouldn't have known how to face him.

As far as Ying Chanxi could remember, the last time she and Li Luo slept in the same bed had to be traced all the way back to the third grade.

They were just little kids back then.

As for after they grew up, this was truly the first time.

This made Ying Chanxi feel a little shy.

Her cheeks felt even hotter, especially when she thought about how, after the movie last night, Senior Sister had probably discovered her already asleep on Li Luo's bed, and Li Luo had no intention of taking her back to her room.

But now that Li Luo wasn't here, she felt a little thrill. She stealthily buried her face in the pillow and took a soft sniff.

She had originally planned to get up, but thinking this was a rare opportunity, Ying Chanxi felt a little reluctant to leave.

Anyway, Senior Sister probably already knew she slept here with Li Luo last night, so Ying Chanxi couldn't be bothered to be secretive about it.

And so, just like that, as she lay there, she groggily fell asleep again.

It wasn't until ten in the morning.

After getting enough sleep in the guest room, Li Luo slowly opened his eyes. He had just sat up in bed when he felt that something wasn't right.

Turning his head to look at Yan Zhusheng sleeping soundly and peacefully beside him, Li Luo was momentarily lost in thought.

Why does every single one of them like to crawl into my bed?

(End of this chapter)
